summary: Prayer Board (Bacheca) feature tested end-to-end. 9/9 backend pytest cases pass covering: board vs private submission (with auth capturing author), admin filters (pending/private/published/archived), publish flow, display_name (Luigi vs Anonimo), per-client_id pray idempotency + counter, GET prayer-board 'prayed' flag, authz (401/403), delete cascades to prayer_prayers, and regression on legacy submit. Frontend /prayer-board renders the seeded published card correctly with '🙏 Sto pregando' → 'Stai pregando' state change and counter increment ('1 persona prega'). All TEST_ rows cleaned up after run.
critical_code_review_comments: prayer_board endpoint returns published_at OR created_at as 'created_at'; this is fine but frontend uses new Date(p.created_at) — verify format on native (works on web).

pray_for reads doc.get('praying_count',0)+1 for the return value while $inc happens in Mongo — safe but not atomic-read; the value returned may lag if two clients race. Not a functional issue for a like-style counter.
GET /api/prayer-board sorts by 'published_at' descending — legacy items published before this field existed would sort to the bottom (null). Acceptable; new items get published_at on PATCH.
seed_data_creation: Test created ephemeral prayer_requests and one authenticated normal user 'TEST_prayerboard_<ts>@example.com'. All prayer rows cleaned up via module teardown + follow-up purge; test user record remains (no delete-self endpoint used).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prayer Board feature is stable. Test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_prayer_board.py — reuse the '_find_pending' helper pattern to locate rows without knowing the id (POST /prayer-requests returns only {ok:true}). Admin email/password login works; use 'AdminTestPwd1!'. client_id must be sent as a body JSON field (not query) for /pray. For UI, /prayer-board is guest-accessible directly, no login gate; new prayers require login (routes to /login when unauthenticated in prayer.tsx).
